decisions.reason: Retaining the ESP32 module's local decoupling-capacitor placement does not change DCDC1 output voltage, regulation, current rating, or rail role.
The source context specifically resolves ESP32 module decoupling, not the separate AXP2101 and MT3608 converter-capacitor placement question.
ESP32 local decoupling placement does not alter battery protection, cutoff voltages, or DW01A protection details.
The decision does not change the MT3608 enable GPIO, default state, powered loads, or other 5V boost-control semantics.
Retaining ESP32 decoupling placement does not change the monitored rails, monitoring device, measurement position, or coverage.
The source concerns ESP32 supply capacitors and does not change AXP2101 exposed-pad heat-transfer or assembly requirements.
ESP32 decoupling placement has no necessary effect on the panel-mounted power-button connector or PWRON routing.
The decision retains local capacitor placement and does not modify the minimum trace width or routing rules for VBUS, +5V, or BAT-.
The ESP32 decoupling decision does not alter the AXP2101 battery/system power path, required rails, charging behavior, or efficiency goal.
The source does not affect charge-status display, CHGLED connector circuitry, or component population requirements.
The decision about ESP32 decoupling does not resolve or change VRTC handling or VBACKUP test-pad access.
Retaining ESP32 decoupling placement does not change the requested PWROK debug test pad or signal-only connection.
